Hi Claire — thanks for the note. We can run a coordinated expunction for CT-A. I want to loop in Marissa (Customer Success) for scheduling and Soojin (Security) for the technical checklist and evidence delivery. High level plan below; will follow with a detailed runbook and artifacts.

High level steps (ETA: 48 hrs from approval):
- Identify all model-serving keys and prefix patterns for CT-A (prompts + outputs).
- Run targeted KV-cache invalidation and prefix purge on serving planes (hot cache + persistent cache).
- Purge prompt-output logs from the ingestion pipeline and archival stores (S3 object deletion + lifecycle markers).
- Execute ledger entry marking and generate a purge_manifest.csv for your records.
- Produce an expunction_evidence PDF with checksums, timestamps, and operator signatures.

Next steps: Marissa — can you work with BasilTech to confirm a 2-hour maintenance window this week? Soojin — please attach the checklist and any preflight queries.

Regards,
Mateo Alvarez

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Claire Zhang <claire@basiltech.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 20 May 2026 12:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: wipe of kv-cache/prompt outputs for user cohort A (PO #4321) — technical checklist

Hi all,

Thanks — below is the technical expunction checklist we'll follow. I included expected artifacts and an initial ETA based on a 2-hour window starting Friday, 2026-05-21 02:00-04:00 PDT. If you need an earlier slot we can compress but will require a backup window.

Preflight (T-24h):
- Confirm exact key prefixes (CT-A) and related model variants.
- Snapshot indexes for forensic retention (hash only, no full content).
- Notify monitoring/alerting to mute expected churn.

Execution (Window):
1) Suspend writes for CT-A routing (serving router flag).
2) Run KV-cache prefix deletion on all serving nodes (result logs: kv_purge_<node>.log).
3) Sweep prompt-output logging topic and delete tombstoned S3 objects with matching lifecycle tags (manifest entry per object).
4) Remove any cached prefix entries in CDN edges if present (invalidate).
5) Update audit ledger with deletion receipts and operator IDs.

Post-run verification (T+30m):
- Re-run prefix presence check (hash queries) across replicas.
- Generate purge_manifest_20260520.csv (fields: object_key, storage_path, utc_timestamp, operator_id, checksum).
- Compile expunction_evidence_20260520.pdf containing checksums, logs snippets (redacted), and operator signatures.

Artifacts delivered to BasilTech via secure transfer:
- purge_manifest_20260520.csv (CSV)
- expunction_evidence_20260520.pdf (signed PDF)
- kv_purge_<node>.log (zipped, redacted)

Security notes: we do not retain full prompt outputs in the evidence PDF; only hashes and redacted snippets where required by your auditors. All transfers use your registered SFTP endpoint or our encrypted share link.

I will own the verification step. Assuming approval now, target completion by 2026-05-21 04:30 PDT.

Soojin Lee
Senior Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

Attachments: checklist_template_v2.pdf
